purpose: verify that one SD 1.5 OpenPose ControlNet changes pose and coarse scene structure before any identity condition is added
control_input: OpenPose body map extracted from each approved held-out scene. Source colors, face, clothing, bag, and background pixels are not passed to ControlNet.
result: At scale 1.0, the four outputs follow the pose-map limb directions and introduce coarse kitchen, railing, cinema, or worktable structure more strongly than scale 0.0. Faces, hair, clothing, and bag do not match Mira, as no identity condition was supplied.
compatibility_finding: waifu-diffusion/wd-1-5-beta3 cannot be paired with this SD 1.5 OpenPose ControlNet: its text context width is 1024 while the ControlNet expects 768. Do not combine this pair.
next_gate: A subsequent identity condition must be independently compatible with the SD 1.5 ControlNet base and compared against this structure-only baseline; do not claim a complete webtoon cut from this result.
